title: TransferOwnershipFlow
wrapsNative: sheet(isPresented:) with a NavigationStack(path:) and navigationDestination(for:) for the three steps, MonarchStepper at the top of each step, MonarchEntityPicker, two MonarchConsequenceLists, MonarchRolePicker and a danger MonarchButton, with interactiveDismissDisabled(_:) while transferring
summary: A recipe, not a component: hand a workspace to another member in three pushed steps (choose the new owner, see what changes for each side, confirm), then wait for them to accept.
whenToUse: When the owner of a workspace or organisation gives ownership to another member, for example before leaving or deleting their account.
whenNotToUse: For changing a member's role other than owner, use MonarchRolePicker in the member's row. For removing a member, use a confirmationDialog.
api: MonarchEntityPicker("New owner", selection: $owner, entities: [MonarchEntityPickerEntity(…, hint: "Only admins can become the owner", isDisabled: true)])
MonarchRolePicker("Your role after the transfer", selection: $yourRole, roles:, layout: .compact)
MonarchButton("Transfer ownership", variant: .danger, isLoading: isTransferring, fullWidth: true)

states.name: choose
states.description: Step 1 of 3: the member picker, with members who cannot become the owner disabled and the reason as their hint; Continue is disabled until someone is chosen.

states.name: what changes
states.description: Step 2 of 3: what changes for you and for the new owner, and your role after the transfer.

states.name: confirm
states.description: Step 3 of 3: the danger button, which shows progress while the transfer starts; the sheet cannot be swiped away.

states.name: pending
states.description: The sheet closes and a banner says the app is waiting for the new owner to accept.

appearance: A system sheet with a navigation bar and the back button on later steps; Monarch's stepper, entity picker, consequence lists, role picker and danger button on the canvas background. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web TransferOwnershipFlow is one component on a WizardDialog with eligibleRoles, a requiresAcceptance mode, a cancel-transfer screen and default consequence messages. On iOS it is a recipe: each step is a screen pushed on a NavigationStack inside the sheet, so the system back button and swipe-back move between steps, and MonarchStepper shows where the person is. Eligibility, the consequences' wording and the pending or immediate result are the app's. Android composes the same recipe.
accessibility: Each step's navigation title and the stepper's spoken progress (step 2 of 3) tell VoiceOver users where they are.
Members who cannot become the owner are disabled rows that read their reason.
MonarchConsequenceList reads each consequence with its kind, so nothing depends on the icon colour.
Announce the result with AccessibilityNotification.Announcement when the sheet closes.
edgeCases: With no eligible member, show MonarchEmptyState on the first step with Invite someone instead of the picker.
Clear the chosen member and pop to the first step each time the sheet opens.
If the transfer fails, stay on the confirm step and show the error with MonarchInlineNotice.
Long member names wrap in the headings For <name>.
